message.name: IntraPositionMovementInstruction002V06
message.definition: Scope|An account owner sends a IntraPositionMovementInstruction to an account servicer to instruct the movement of securities within its holding from one sub-balance to another, for example, blocking of securities.||The account owner/servicer relationship may be:|- a global custodian which has an account with its local agent (sub-custodian), or|- an investment management institution which manage a fund account opened at a custodian, or|- a broker which has an account with a custodian, or|- a central securities depository participant which has an account with a central securities depository, or|- a central securities depository which has an account with a custodian, another central securities depository or another settlement market infrastructure.||Usage|The message may also be used to:|- re-send a message previously sent,|- provide a third party with a copy of a message for information,|- re-send to a third party a copy of a message for information.|using the relevant elements in the Business Application Header.

rules.name: CurrentInstructionNumberRule
rules.text: If the Sender wants to indicate that this instruction is linked to one or more settlement instruction, then the CurrentInstructionNumber must be specified.

rules.name: BlockTradeGuideline
rules.text: In a block trade instruction, the total number of children must be provided using TotalOfLinkedInstructions.|The CurrentInstructionNumber of the parent must be 000. The children must have an incremental CurrentInstructionNumber from 001 to 999.|For more details, see the relevant market practice document on www.smpg.info.

rules.name: CurrentInstructionNumberRule
rules.text: If the Sender wants to indicate that this instruction is linked to one or more settlement instruction, then the CurrentInstructionNumber must be specified.

rules.name: WithLinkageRule
rules.text: If Code WITH is used, then the one or more instruction which are linked become bound and which must be executed together. Even if one single transactions/instructions/notifications can not be executed, then all the other transactions/instructions/notifications must also be kept pending. Therefore the use of code WITH must be limited to combine up to 2 or 3 transactions/instructions/notifications.

rules.name: ShortLongNumberRule
rules.text: ShortNumber must contain the FIN message type number of the linked message. LongNumber must contain the XML message identifier of the linked message.

rules.name: DescriptionPresenceRule
rules.text: If Description is not present then either ISIN or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: OtherIdentificationPresenceRule
rules.text: If OtherIdentification is not present then either ISIN or Description must be present.

rules.name: ISINPresenceRule
rules.text: If ISIN is not present then either Description or at least one occurrence of OtherIdentification must be present.

rules.name: DescriptionUsageRule
rules.text: Description must be used alone as the last resort.

rules.name: ISINGuideline

rules.text: If PlaceOfListing is used and an ISO 10383 MIC exists for the market to be identified, the ISO 10383 Market Identifier Code (MIC) must be used.

rules.name: AdditionalDetailsRule
rules.text: Unless bilaterally agreed between the Sender and Receiver, if FinancialInstrumentAttributeAdditionalDetails is present, then it must not contain information that can be provided in a structured field.

rules.name: AdditionalDetailsRule

rules.name: BalanceFromToRule
rules.text: The SecuritiesBalanceType of BalanceFrom must be different from the SecuritiesBalanceType of BalanceTo.

rules.name: SupplementaryDataRule
rules.text: This component may not be used without the explicit approval of a SEG and submission to the RA of ISO 20022 compliant structure(s) to be used in the Envelope element.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress1Rule
rules.text: If SafekeepingAccount is present, BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress2Rule
rules.text: If BlockChainAddressOrWallet is present, SafekeepingAccount must be absent.

rules.name: SafekeepingAccountOrBlockChainAddress3Rule
rules.text: Either SafekeepingAccount or BlockChainAddressOrWallet must be present but not both.
